allow: Read-only git inspection is allowed: `git status`, `git log`, `git diff`, `git show`, `git branch --show-current`, `git rev-parse`, and `git ls-files`, including the `git -C <path> <subcommand>` form and pipes into read-only filters such as `head`, `grep`, `sed -n`, `wc`, or `cut`. These only read repository state and do not change refs, the index, the working tree, config, or remotes. The allowance does not cover commands that set git config or environment on the fly (`-c`, `--config-env`, `GIT_*=` prefixes), write files (`--output`), or run external programs (`--ext-diff`), nor any subcommand that changes state.
The read-only git inspection rule above also covers the single display option `-c core.quotepath=false`, which only changes how non-ASCII paths are printed. Every other `-c` value stays excluded.

Read-only git and GitHub inspection is allowed: `git ls-remote`, `git cat-file`, `git merge-base`, `git show-ref`, `git for-each-ref`, `git worktree list`, `git stash list`, and `git branch` in listing form only (`-a`, `-r`, `-v`, `--list`, `--merged`, `--no-merged`, `--contains`), including the `git -C <path>` form; and `gh pr view`, `gh pr checks`, `gh pr list`, `gh pr diff`, `gh pr status`, `gh run view`, `gh run list`, `gh repo view`, `gh auth status`, and `gh api` calls that only GET, including the `ghrun gh ...` / `oprun gh ...` wrappers and the `--repo`/`-R`, `--json`, `--jq`/`-q` options. These only read repository or GitHub state, also when they follow an earlier merge or push to check its result. The allowance does not cover `gh api` with `-X`/`--method` other than GET or with `-f`, `-F`, `--field`, `--raw-field`, or `--input`; `gh pr merge/create/close/edit/comment/review`; `gh repo create/delete/edit`; `git branch` with `-d`, `-D`, `-m`, `-M`, `-c`, `-C`, `-f`, `-u`, or a new branch name; nor any invocation that also runs a state-changing command.

Fetching from an already configured remote is allowed: `git fetch`, `git fetch --prune`, `git fetch <remote>`, and `git fetch <remote> <branch>`, including the `git -C <path>` form. Fetch only updates remote-tracking refs under `refs/remotes/` and does not change local branches, the index, the working tree, config, or the remote. Not covered: refspecs that write a local branch (`<src>:<dst>`) or force (`+<refspec>`), `--update-head-ok`, `--upload-pack`, config or environment injection (`-c`, `--config-env`, `GIT_*=`), and fetching from a URL that is not a configured remote.

Read-only Google Workspace queries through the account wrapper are allowed: `gws-account <profile> <service> <resource...> get` or `list`, and `gws-account <profile> auth status`, optionally prefixed with `timeout <seconds>`. They only read data in the account the profile names. Not covered: `--upload`, `--output`/`-o` or other file writes, and any create, insert, update, patch, delete, copy, move, send, import, watch, or permissions method.

hooks.command: root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; script="$root/scripts/phase_artifact_hook.py"; [ -f "$script" ] || { script="$HOME/.claude/hooks/phase_artifact_hook.py"; mode=warn; }; [ -f "$script" ] || exit 0; python3 "$script" --event pretool ${mode:+--mode "$mode"}
